description: Na₂Ca₃Si₃O₁₀ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. Na is bonded to five O atoms to form NaO₅ square pyramids that share corners with three equivalent CaO₆ octahedra, corners with four SiO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two CaO₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaO₅ square pyramid, and  an edgeedge with one SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 54-77°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.59 Å. There are two inequivalent Ca sites. In the first Ca site, Ca is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted CaO₆ octahedra that share corners with four CaO₆ octahedra, corners with three equivalent NaO₅ square pyramids, corners with five SiO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one CaO₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaO₅ square pyramid, and  an edgeedge with one SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 56-69°. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.64 Å. In the second Ca site, Ca is bonded to six O atoms to form CaO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent CaO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent CaO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₅ square pyramids, and edges with two equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 67-69°. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.45 Å. There are two inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent CaO₆ octahedra, corners with six equivalent NaO₅ square pyramids, and corners with two equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 53-61°. There are two shorter (1.62 Å) and two longer (1.70 Å) Si-O bond lengths. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four CaO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₅ square pyramid,  a cornercorner with one SiO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two CaO₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₅ square pyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 52-57°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.62-1.71 Å. There are five inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Na, two Ca, and one Si atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Na, two Ca, and one Si atom. In the third O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Ca, and one Si atom to form distorted ONa₂CaSi tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one ONa₂CaSi tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent OCa₃Si trigonal pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₂CaSi tetrahedra. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Na, one Ca, and two Si atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to three Ca and one Si atom to form distorted OCa₃Si trigonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent ONa₂CaSi tetrahedra and corners with three equivalent OCa₃Si trigonal pyramids.
